issues.reason: Thematic roles bounds Holder to possession verbs "own / have / lack" and gives "the tank holds forty litres" as the stative transitive that still takes Agent, so (Holder sk_hold_1 sk_mire_essence_1) asserts a possession relation the rule bars for exactly this verb.

Core patterns forbids silently dropping a stated restriction ("omitting it widens the claim"), and the licensed carrier plainly exists — the parse itself emits (Possession sk_lantern_1 middle_row) for the parallel "the lanterns of the Middle Row" — so the keepers' of-phrase is an omitted licensed atom, not gap territory.

The continuation copular ("stayed lit") mandates the reified state plus the flat atom (Dual-emit; Resultatives), which on a plural group becomes the per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_lantern_1) (Member $x lit)); only the reified half was emitted, so no member's "is it lit?" can bind.

Depositing leaves the threads themselves unaltered, so the "does the object itself change?" test — and its explicit default-to-Theme fallback — yields Theme; Patient asserts a change the leaving does not make.

This mistakes a coverage gap for a defect (the reviewer files it as gap 2 as well): Ordinal's scale slot has no licensed filler for a plain object noun with no associated event or "-est" dimension, and (Ordinal sk_cauldron_1 1 cauldron) asserts nothing false — it records the stated rank, which Core patterns forbids silently dropping.

Instrument's own gloss covers "a tool, substance or conduit" as the means, and the preposition-named oblique is reserved for PPs naming what the activity is about or directed at, so sea-water as the medium the boiling is done in is a licensed reading (Location is already taken by the cauldron in the same clause).

gaps_confirmed: Day-of-year ordinal dating ("on day 460 of Year 2"): (Day n) is defined as the day granularity of a calendar expression paired with (Month ...), so a day numbered within the year has no distinct licensed form.

An ordinal ranking a plain object noun with no associated event and no "-est" dimension ("the first cauldron"): no licensed filler exists for Ordinal's scale slot — this is the hole behind refuted issue 4.

A per-member distribution rule whose predicate is TRANSITIVE with a plural/group object ("the keepers lit the lanterns", "the nightmoths left silken threads"): every distributive example in the instruction set is intransitive and nothing says whether the object co-distributes, so the shared-symbol convention makes each member act on the whole group.

Cross-part-of-speech lemma collision: the verb "lit" lemmatizes to light and the noun head of "mist-light" also gives light, and lemmatization offers no sense split, so the lighting event class and the noun genus share one symbol.
new_gaps: A medium PP naming the substance an action is performed in ("boiled the threads in sea-water") has no decision rule: Instrument is defined by means, Location by place, and the preposition-named oblique by aboutness, so nothing selects among them for a medium — which is why issue 5 is underdetermined.

A bare mass direct object later taken up by a definite anaphor ("burned mire-essence" ... "The mire-essence in the lanterns ..."): Existential reserves the bare class symbol for a non-specific object, but a bare class symbol gives the later definite nothing to attach its predications to, so the two rules pull opposite ways and no licensed form covers both.
defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant form is (Agent sk_hold_1 sk_mire_essence_1) — a stative transitive keeps Agent, Holder being own/have/lack only. Issue 1: add (Possession sk_keeper_1 middle_row) beside (GroupOf sk_keeper_1 keeper), exactly as the parallel lantern phrase is handled. Issue 2: add the flat half of the dual-emit as the per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_lantern_1) (Member $x lit)) (STV 1.0 0.9) beside the reified state. Issue 3: the compliant role is (Theme sk_leave_1 sk_thread_1).
notes: The passage is otherwise well tracked — two distinct keeper groups, two distinct mire-essence witnesses, clean compound decompositions, "by evening" as TimeAtMost, and Location-on-the-event-only for the creating/positioning clauses. Beyond the filed gap, the six transitive distribution rules arguably over-assert rather than merely improvise (each keeper lighting the whole lantern group, each lantern producing the one mist-light), which a re-parse should settle rather than replicate.
